'''Blue-rated constable''' was a rank that sat below [[indigo-rated constable]] in the hierarchy of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. The brigade was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] arm of [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], the corporation that ruled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. Like all constable brigade ranks, the title of blue-rated constable was derived from a [[Color/Legends|color]] of light.<ref name="Strongholds" />

Blue-rated constables had authority on Sullust and off-world SoroSuub facilities. They served as investigators and were able to track criminals across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The majority of blue-rated constables hoped to eventually become indigo-rated constables, as they received more dangerous cases. The constables were armed with [[Light blaster pistol/Legends|light]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Armored Clothing|armored clothing]]. They had [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills and were more difficult to bribe than the lower-ranking [[orange-rated constable]]s.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of blue-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]]. The statistics for the blue-rated constable in ''Strongholds of Resistance'' incorrectly refer to the rank as an orange-rated constable, despite that rank having a separate entry.<ref name="Strongholds" />
